[[Valgar Tempestcrafter]] is a [[Norn]] [[artisan|metallurgist]], who only makes special [[item]]s.

==Locations==
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
*** {{NPC location|Olafstead}}
*[[Guild Wars Beyond]]
** [[Hearts of the North]]
*** {{NPC location|Hall of Monuments}} (during the first dialogue after completing [[Reunion]])
*** {{NPC location|Olafstead|explorable area}} (during [[The Wedding]])

==Dialogue==
;Olafstead
:''"Creating a piece of armor is nothing. Crafting something that will stand against time and combat is true mastery."''

;Hall of Monuments (only during [[Hearts of the North dialogues#Dialogue 15 - A Norn to the Rescue!|Hearts of the North dialogue scene]])
:''"Ha! You must be an excellent hunter to have seen through my camouflage. I came here as soon as I heard that my friend Keiran had returned. I wish to hear his epic tale! But now I find my good friend in trouble, facing insurmountable odds. What a challenge this wedding must be! A challenge fit only for a legendary Norn. Very well, leave this to me!"''

;Olafstead (during the Wedding)
:''"Ah, a fine Norn wedding this turned out to be. I knew this was a feat worthy of my mighty prowess!"''
